meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 统一管理多智能体角色的团队协作框架，支持智能体动态组合、灵活协作和扩展新角色。智能体本质上是"角色定义"，可以根据任务需求灵活组建团队，实现从会议决策到系统构建的完整能力。智能体角色明确分工：有干活的、有指挥的、有挑毛病的，能实时看到沟通过程，共享数据库记忆，确保上下文一致。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建多智能体团队协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理多个智能体角色并协调它们协作完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent teams to collaborate on tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple AI agents and coordinate their collaboration

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按角色组建多智能体团队，让它们分工协作处理任务，并实时展示智能体之间的讨论过程，同时共享统一数据库记忆。
howto.when: 当用户要求多个智能体协同完成复杂任务，或需要管理特定场景的智能体组合时触发。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构方案
say.note: 各智能体会发言、辩论并形成决策记录

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 战略、产品、工程智能体依次产出方案与代码

say.text: 请用产品团队制定某产品定价策略
say.note: 市场、财务、销售角色协作给出定价结论

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude assembles a multi-agent team with distinct roles, coordinates task execution, displays agent discussions in real time, and shares a unified database memory.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for multi-agent collaboration on a complex task, or needs to manage a specific team composition for a scenario.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to evaluate the microservices plan.
say_en.note: Agents discuss, debate, and produce a decision record.

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short videos.
say_en.note: Strategy, product, and engineering agents produce outputs in sequence.

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for a product.
say_en.note: Marketing, finance, and sales roles collaborate on a pricing result.
